text:
deploy-bot: Release v2026.03.20 to production paused — preflight detected env-parity failure: secret 'proxy-cert' present but key path differs between staging and prod (staging: 'tls.cert', prod: 'tls_cert').
sam: copying. which service hit the check?
laura: proxy-service during preflight config validation.
matt: canary went green earlier, weird the key name changed in prod only.
priya: we shipped a chart change last week that renamed the tls key in values.yaml, maybe staging stayed on older chart
sam: i'll query prod secrets
sam: kubectl -n infra get secret proxy-cert -o yaml
sam: ```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: proxy-cert
data:
  tls_cert: <redacted-base64>
``` 
laura: staging shows:
laura: ```
data:
  tls.cert: <redacted-base64>
```
matt: dot vs underscore. classic.
jordan: is this from the helm values rename or from our secret-renderer job?
priya: helm chart v2.1.0 changed the key to tls_cert. staging was pinned to v2.0.2 so it kept tls.cert. prod migrated to 2.1.0 during last infra push.
sam: So deploybot expected parity across envs and failed the check. What do people want to do — hotpatch prod or pause release?
laura: do not proceed without fix. short-term: create a compat key in prod with the old name and restart pods.
matt: I can craft a kubectl apply to add tls.cert using the same value.
sam: applying now, creating secret patch
sam: ```
kubectl -n infra patch secret proxy-cert --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/data/tls.cert","value":"<redacted-base64>"}]'
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/proxy-service
```
deploy-bot: Manual intervention recorded: @sam added legacy key to secret proxy-cert in prod. Release still paused until deploybot preflight re-check.
sam: patch applied, pods restarted.
laura: monitoring canary logs and readiness
matt: canary looks healthy at 2/2
deploy-bot: Preflight re-check: OK. Resuming release. :rocket:
priya: follow-up: we should normalize key names or accept both variants in renderer. Filing INF-4321 to reconcile chart values and secret-generator.
jordan: also add an automated parity check to CI for secret key names before promo.
sam: noted — I'll add a blurb to release notes: "Hotpatch applied for proxy-cert key mismatch; follow-up ticket INF-4321 created." 
laura: thanks all. keep an eye on error rates for the hour.
matt: noted, I'll watch the proxy-service SLOs.
priya: closing this thread, but please add any anomalies to the ticket.
